page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top centre. Left and right margins hold no printed notes: only show-through and a red stamp at the right edge, which are omitted. Catchword at the lower right, signature at the foot.

main_text.p: fita fuit apud Archenomidem Anagy-rafium, ut ipse in judicio est testatus. E sfretus ille, in cujus gratiam Demosthenes orationem hanc scripsit, Lacritum fratrem & hæredem Artemonis, & contractus hujusce conciliatorem præcipuum, & fraternæ fidei sponsorem, tum vero debitum defuncti, cujus hæreditatem tenebat, solvere recusantem, & effugia varia quærentem in jus vocavit, hominem, ut orator eum describit, iniquum, versipellem, eloquentiæ suæ fidentem, discipulum Isocratis rhetoris celeberrimi. Verum nullis repagulis comprimi libido fallendi potuit, quominus iret quò vellet. Comminiscebantur homines fraudulenti varios dolos, ut pecunias aliorum fidei suæ commissas prætextu calamitatis alicujus, aut fraudis sibi ab aliis factæ, in se verterent, & specie quâdam juris, aut æqui & boni. creditores suos fortunis exuebant, iisque sese locupletabant. Detestandæ artes, hodie quoq; in scenâ mercatorum exultantes. Quibus si frenum lege & potestate publicâ injiceretur, minus magnorum furtorum fieret, & rectius fidei contractuum & commerciorum consuleretur. Sed longius heic eo,quàm instituti mei ratio poscit. page.notes: Long s rendered as s throughout. Catchword "dem" = fidem. The page opens mid-sentence, so the first paragraph is a continuation. Left-margin fragments (small marks at the left edge) and the red stamp and fragments at the right edge appear to be show-through or a library stamp, so they are omitted. Bottom-right fragments ("-si fi-", "-y ꝯ") are faint and look like show-through from the facing page, so they are omitted. Word "miniscebantur" (line 17) is read from a broken-up word and is printed as "Com-minisc-ebantur" across the line break; the letter forms are clear enough to transcribe, but the reading is worth checking.
